Starting line is net loss available to common shareholders as printed (the company's table begins there, not at consolidated net income). Core AFFO is shown with no per-share figure. 'Land and other impairments' is classified 'other' because it is land (non-depreciable) impairment, not depreciable real estate impairment. 'Lease breakage fee, net' is classified 'other' as it fits no listed category. 'Amortization of lease inducements' is classified 'other'. 'Amortization of market lease intangibles, net' is classified straight_line_rent as a similar non-cash revenue item. Debt discount/mark-to-market line shows '–' (zero) for Q1 2022 and is omitted.
